content: <thought>Based on the mass spectrometry data, the most intense ion is at m/z 183.0451, which likely corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.0073 Da) gives an estimated neutral molecular mass of ~182.038 Da. This mass is consistent with a molecular formula such as C₉H₁₀O₄ (exact mass 182.0576 Da) or a close isomer. To pinpoint the exact structure efficiently, I will retrieve the 13C NMR spectrum, which will reveal the number and types of carbon environments and help narrow down the possible isomers without performing costly additional experiments.
